description: This Java interface defines a delegated command sender used to send command messages to downstream peers within Eclipse Hono. It includes a method to send command messages with OpenTracing context, returning a future that indicates the outcome.

classes.name: DelegatedCommandSender
classes.description: An interface for sending command messages delegated to a downstream peer, extending MessageSender.

methods.name: sendCommandMessage
methods.description: Sends a command message to a downstream peer, accepting a Command object and optional OpenTracing SpanContext, returning a Future of ProtonDelivery indicating success or failure.
